scale: absolute dBFS at the master (REC at unity since 1b.0; the chain proven in bank/reference.json)
standard: K-20 (Katz / SMPTE RP 200); loudness ITU-R BS.1770. REC is at unity since 1b.0, so every level is dBFS AT THE MASTER (bank/reference.json proves the chain to three decimals).

method.maxMomentary: loudest 400 ms, K-weighted (BS.1770 pre-filter) — how it speaks
method.integrated: K-weighted RMS over the whole sounding note — how loud it is
method.soundingS: onset to 40 dB below the note's own peak
method.cents: f0 by autocorrelation, searched within ±6 semitones of the written pitch
